system.description:
Blunderbuss [Parry: 6+] [Stun: 4+]

Parry: roll 1d per each bullet you mark. With a result equal [Parry] you interrupt an enemy action.

Stun: roll 1d per every two bullets you mark. With a result equal [Stun] you stun an enemy for a few seconds.

Reload: mark any amount of Blood and/or Silver Bullets. For each, roll 1d. Regain bullets equal to the highest result.
